description: Look up one roofing contractor license by state and license number. Returns status as published by the state regulator, a machine-readable verdict, licensee name, city, expiration, and provenance (regulator source URL + fetch date). Verdicts: licensed-active (current and active), licensed-not-active (in roster but inactive/suspended/probation), not-in-roster (not in the bulk extract but has discipline records and/or a live regulator result — typically revoked, null/void, or delinquent; includes liveStatus and discipline), not-found (no record anywhere). The verdict is derived from the regulator-published status, not a recommendation. Use this when a user asks "is this roofing contractor licensed" or has a license number from a truck, yard sign, ad, or contract.

license_number.description: License number as printed, e.g. CCC1325838 or CGC061405; hyphens/spaces are ignored

state.description: Two-letter state code or state name, e.g. FL, tx, Florida

name: check_license
